title: Article 43A — Participation of workers in management of industries

content.overview: Article 43A directs the State to take steps, by suitable legislation or otherwise, to secure the participation of workers in the management of undertakings, establishments or other organisations engaged in any industry.

sections.heading: Directive content
sections.body: Worker-participation policy; implementation is legislative. Related: Art 37.

sections.heading: Track B
sections.body: Implement through statute or scheme. Article 37 bars treating this as a freestanding justiciable right.
